//extends: The shared options moved to tsconfig.base.json so the eight package tsconfigs inherit exactly what this program uses. This config stays the WHOLE-TREE program - src, test and the gate itself, no rootDir, no references - which is what `tsc --noEmit` checks and what eslint's project service resolves a test file against. The eight package programs are the WALL and run after it, as one `tsc -b` over tsconfig.wall.json.
//allowJs: eslint.config.js IS the gate (§15.2). test/gate/gate.test.ts imports it so the block-tests and allow-tests run the SHIPPED rule objects rather than a copy — there is no second implementation to drift.
//exclude: test/gate/fixtures holds DELIBERATELY BROKEN source — it is input to the gate's block-tests, not part of the build. test/gate/.work is the exhaustiveness proof's scratch copy. test/laws/fixtures/citations is the same shape one layer up: input to the reference lint's block-test.
